answer: Add up the farm's invoices and the total is 71280 POA, due before the epoch hands out a single coin. Stake 3 times the reward and the farm must park 71280 POA to chase 648 seats it will likely never win. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. One proof settles it, and it reads Parchment stretcher calfskin proof stretched on the cutting table, spelled out in full as each calfskin is a season of stretched skins plus a signed parchment record. A walnut can be painted, a sable can be borrowed, but a terrace must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing.
